premise: In the morning mist Raccoon and Ladybug find a shining silver line across the moss and follow it, sure it leads to treasure; it leads to Snail, who leaves it so friends can always find him.
inspiration: Hansel and Gretel's breadcrumb trail (Grimm), turned: no one is lost and no trail is eaten; the trail is a gift that says come find me.
lesson: The best trail is one that leads to a friend.
learning: A snail leaves a shiny silver trail wherever he goes.

en-US.title: Snail's Silver Trail
en-US.text: {canvas:fog 0.6 18s} {sfx:mist} [whispers] The morning was full of mist, and Raccoon {raccoon:pulse} could hardly see their own paws. But there, on the moss, was something shining. A thin silver line. [curious] Treasure? said Raccoon. Ladybug {ladybug:hop} landed beside it. That way, she said. So they followed it. {raccoon:hop} Over a root. Around a stone. It never broke. It glittered {raccoon:sparkle} through the mist. {sfx:sniff} Raccoon sniffed it. It smells like… somebody. The trail went under the mushroom {mushroom:pulse} and on. And then the mist began to lift, and at the end of the silver line sat… Snail. {snail:fade-in 2s} [surprised] Snail! We followed your treasure! Snail smiled, slowly. That is not treasure, he said. That is me. I leave it wherever I go. {snail:glow #DDE8FF} So my friends can always find me. [happily] And from then on, whenever the mist came down, they knew exactly which way to go.

es-ES.title: El rastro de plata de Caracol
es-ES.text: {canvas:fog 0.6 18s} {sfx:mist} [whispers] La mañana estaba llena de niebla, y Mapache {raccoon:pulse} casi no se veía las patas. Pero allí, sobre el musgo, había algo que brillaba. Una línea fina de plata. [curious] ¿Un tesoro?, dijo Mapache. Mariquita {ladybug:hop} se posó al lado. Por allí, dijo. Y la siguieron. {raccoon:hop} Por encima de una raíz. Alrededor de una piedra. Nunca se cortaba. Brillaba {raccoon:sparkle} a través de la niebla. {sfx:sniff} Mapache la olió. Huele a… alguien. La línea pasaba por debajo de la seta {mushroom:pulse} y seguía. Y entonces la niebla empezó a levantarse, y al final de la línea de plata estaba… Caracol. {snail:fade-in 2s} [surprised] ¡Caracol! ¡Hemos seguido tu tesoro! Caracol sonrió, despacio. Eso no es un tesoro, dijo. Soy yo. Lo dejo por donde voy. {snail:glow #DDE8FF} Así mis amigos siempre pueden encontrarme. [happily] Y desde entonces, cuando bajaba la niebla, sabían exactamente por dónde ir.

mist.prompt: a hushed misty forest morning, muffled and still, a few water drops falling from leaves

sniff.prompt: a curious animal sniffing the ground twice, close and soft
